verdict_A_requirement_coverage.verdict: PARTIAL — SOURCE-READY WITH OPEN COVERAGE AND NATIVE EVIDENCE GAPS
basis: The three inherited findings are addressed in source: Settings and tab-pane controls share a selector that includes anchors; censusCompleteness rejects empty required regions and requires the source-present Settings sections; unknown labels are HMAC-SHA-256 fingerprinted with a fresh 256-bit per-run key, with no raw unknown label or length in the report.

The repair's source tests now assert the missing OpenUrl anchor maps to EXT-F-1003-C39 without serializing its href, exercise nonempty-region requirements, and compare fingerprints made with independent keys. The repair report records seven targeted tests passing, but this review did not run tests and the report does not include a saved test log or resource journal. Treat that as unverified execution evidence, not a test failure.

Control discovery remains selector-bounded. Navigation only queries button[role=tab][title] and Settings sections only query button[aria-expanded]. A visible tab or expander outside those element/attribute shapes is omitted before unknown-label accounting and does not necessarily make the census incomplete. This leaves a path to a falsely complete control inventory.

Member/admin auth is delegated to signInSettings and its returned role/session fields are included. Guest auth is recorded as the requested role only; the census does not explicitly capture a signed-out account/token state in the guest report. The fresh owned profile supports the guest setup, but the emitted per-role actual-auth evidence is weaker than for member/admin.

Receipt checks bind imported development artifact source SHA, CI run ID, artifact ID, tree digest, extension ID, and version before reporting. The read-only source delta from CI source 00a19a14553252c7a25c6f4fc440197ae49dbaeb to reviewed HEAD is empty for src, package/config, scripts, and the native harness; this supports using that frozen artifact with the current census harness after source review. It is not a native execution result.
verdict_A_requirement_coverage.disposition: The original selector, vacuous-completeness, and deterministic-hash findings are fixed. Do not treat a complete status as a full control-class census until tab/section discovery accounts for alternate interactive shapes and guest signed-out state is recorded. Native guest/member/admin reports remain required before claiming role visibility.

verdict_B_quality_and_safety.verdict: PARTIAL — PRIVACY AND RECEIPT BOUNDARIES IMPROVED; DISCOVERY AND EVIDENCE NEED FOLLOW-THROUGH
basis: The repair removes guessable cross-run hashes: the HMAC key is generated once per driver run, embedded only into page evaluation, and omitted from serialized output. mapObservation rejects raw unknown labels without a valid fingerprint.

Receipt/source identity checks happen before native startup. Reports use mode 0600 and the network guard aborts non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS HTTP(S) methods on the sidepanel and extension-worker targets, recording only boundary/category counts. Direct tab navigation and Settings expansion are the only census actions; product action controls are not activated.

The request guard is intentionally limited to sidepanel and extension-worker targets, and POST/RPC aborts can include reads; both limits are disclosed in the repair report. No general browser-wide no-write guarantee is established.

The remaining selector gap also affects quality: unrecognized interactive shapes can evade both the unknown-label count and required-region checks. Source tests cover the cited anchor, empty census, and keyed fingerprint cases, but do not provide a saved execution log/resource journal in the repair report.

findings.finding: Discovery is restricted to titled button tabs and aria-expanded buttons. An interactive tab/section trigger using another semantic element or without those attributes is silently outside the census, so completeness may still be true despite an omitted region.
findings.why_it_matters: The requested census must make missing or unknown regions explicit; completeness cannot depend solely on the discovery selector already knowing the control's markup shape.

findings.finding: Guest authentication evidence is initialized as {role: 'guest'} without an explicit signed-out identity/storage observation. Member/admin paths include fields returned by signInSettings.
findings.why_it_matters: A role-labeled guest report should carry observed auth state so the three role reports have comparable actual-auth evidence.
